Container.Name: hi10-downloader
Container.Overview: Persistent web interface for Hi10: capture or import a login session, browse and scan projects, select video quality, and track downloads. Build or load hi10-downloader:local before installation; this image is not published to Community Applications.

Config.Name: Web Interface Port
Config.Description: Port for the Hi10 web interface.

Config.Name: Web Interface Password
Config.Description: Password to unlock the app, separate from Hi10 credentials. Leave blank to generate one in appdata/web-password.json.

Config.Name: WordPress Username
Config.Description: Optional Hi10 username/email. Used with the password when you open the login browser; you can also enter credentials in the web UI.

Config.Name: WordPress Password
Config.Description: Optional Hi10 password. Used only for browser login. Complete CAPTCHA and save the session in the web UI. This value is stored in the unRAID template and container environment.

Config.Name: Download Location
Config.Description: Host folder for project folders and downloaded MKV files. Must be writable by UID 99 and GID 100.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Private persistent state, backups and session cookies. Keep writable by UID 99 and GID 100.
